answer: A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The oasis counter is kept in jetty and willow publishes each reset. An farming party as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Repeating the trick 60 times costs 6 separate deposits and 55 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
